entries.title: II Corinthians 5:1
segments: ¶For we know that if our earthly tabernacle house be destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:2
segments: For indeed in this we groan, ardently desiring to have put on our house which [is] from heaven;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:3
segments: if indeed being also clothed we shall not be found naked.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:4
segments: For indeed we who are in the tabernacle groan, being burdened; while yet we do not wish to be unclothed, but clothed, that [what is] mortal may be swallowed up by life.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:5
segments: Now he that has wrought us for this very thing [is] God, who also has given to us the earnest of the Spirit.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:6
segments: Therefore [we are] always confident, and know that while present in the body we are absent from the Lord,

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:7
segments: (for we walk by faith, not by sight;)

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:8
segments: we are confident, I say, and pleased rather to be absent from the body and present with the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:9
segments: Wherefore also we are zealous, whether present or absent, to be agreeable to him.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:10
segments: For we must all be manifested before the judgment-seat of the Christ, that each may receive the things [done] in the body, according to those he has done, whether [it be] good or evil.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:11
segments: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord we persuade men, but have been manifested to God, and I hope also that we have been manifested in your consciences.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:12
segments: ¶[For] we do not again commend ourselves to you, but [we are] giving to you occasion of boast in our behalf, that ye may have [such] with those boasting in countenance, and not in heart.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:13
segments: For whether we are beside ourselves, [it is] to God; or are sober, [it is] for you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:14
segments: For the love of the Christ constrains us, having judged this: that one died for all, then all have died;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:15
segments: and he died for all, that they who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who died for them and has been raised.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:16
segments: ¶So that *we* henceforth know no one according to flesh; but if even we have known Christ according to flesh, yet now we know [him thus] no longer.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:17
segments: So if any one [be] in Christ, [there is] a new creation; the old things have passed away; behold all things have become new:

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:18
segments: and all things [are] of the God who has reconciled us to himself by [Jesus] Christ, and given to us the ministry of that reconciliation:

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:19
segments: how that God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their offences; and putting in us the word of that reconciliation.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:20
segments: We are ambassadors therefore for Christ, God as [it were] beseeching by us, we entreat for Christ, Be reconciled to God.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:21
segments: Him who knew not sin he has made sin for us, that *we* might become God's righteousness in him.
